subtitle: Texts, behaviour and handoff rules of the Telegram bot, quick reply templates and CSV exports. Changes take effect immediately.
readOnlySubtitle: View only: the bot settings are changed by the administrator.

loadError.title: Could not load the settings
loadError.text: Try again: nothing has been lost.

unavailable.title: CRM is not responding
unavailable.text: Wait a minute and try again: nothing has been lost.

forbidden.title: Not available to your role
forbidden.text: The bot settings are available to the administrator and the director (view only).

sectionHints.web_form: Anti-spam for the "Request" form on the Cabinet sign-in page (no external services): a hidden field, a signed form token and a per-IP limit. A lead from the website lands in "Inbox" as "Unassigned".
sectionHints.business_hours: SLA, reminders and the bot's off-hours text depend on working hours.
sectionHints.texts: What the bot writes to customers. Each text is in three languages.
sectionHints.stop_words: A message with a stop word is handed to a manager at once. "word*" — any ending.
sectionHints.competitors: Mentioning a competitor is a reason to hand off to a manager.
sectionHints.escalation: When the bot hands the dialog to the team and how fast the team must reply.
sectionHints.notifications: Where handoff cards go and whom to mention in reminders.
sectionHints.budget: The daily limit of AI model spend.
sectionHints.service_alerts: Whom to write to when an external service (Telegram, AI models, mail…) breaks and when it recovers. One message about the failure and one about the recovery.
sectionHints.deals: Rejection reasons for closing a deal and the currency of new deals.

form.step1: The values of "{{section}}" are saved to CRM as a whole.
form.step2: The bot and staff start working by the new values at once, without a restart.
form.step3: The change goes to the CRM audit log: who and when, the old and the new value.

guard.title: Leave without saving?
guard.text: The form has unsaved changes — they will be lost.

qualificationHint: A lead becomes "Qualified" when all required facts are known and at least the set number of additional ones. The AI extracts the facts, the system decides.
channelMoved: The team channel is chosen in "External integrations" → Telegram; here — whom to mention and how often to write to a manager.

dryRun.title: Dry run of handoff rules
dryRun.hint: Shows how many handoffs to a manager there would be with the values in the form. Changes nothing.
dryRun.step1: The rules are counted on the bot's last 50 dialogs with the values currently in the form, even unsaved ones.
dryRun.step2: You will see how many handoffs to a manager there are now and how many there would be, and which leads it concerns.
dryRun.step3: Nothing is saved or changed: neither settings, nor dialogs, nor leads.
dryRun.nothingChanges: Changes: 0 — the result on these dialogs does not change.

templates.title: Reply templates
templates.intro: Ready replies a manager inserts into the reply field in the lead card and edits before sending. Placeholders: {name} — the lead's name, {manager} — the manager's name.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.text: Create the first one — for example, "I will send the quote today". Managers will see it in the lead card.

templates.tableScroll: Reply templates: the table can be scrolled
templates.caption: Quick reply templates
templates.titleHint: Visible to the manager in the template list, not sent to the customer.
templates.placeholders: Placeholders: {name} — the lead's name, {manager} — the manager's name. The Russian text is required.
templates.fallbackHint: Empty — the Russian text is used.
templates.step1: The template is saved to CRM and appears for managers in the quick replies list in the lead card.
templates.step2: The manager inserts the text into the reply field and edits it before sending: the customer gets what the manager confirmed.
templates.step3: The change goes to the CRM audit log: who and when.
templates.removeStep1: The template disappears from the quick replies list in lead cards.
templates.removeStep2: It cannot be restored: save the text separately if it is still needed.
templates.removeStep3: The deletion goes to the CRM audit log together with the template text.

exports.title: CSV exports
exports.intro: An Excel file with what is visible in CRM lists: leads, customers, deals. Filters are the same as on the list screens.
exports.step1: A CSV file (UTF-8, ";" separator) is downloaded to your device; it has at most 10,000 rows. CRM prepares it and streams it.
exports.step2: The export goes to the CRM audit log: who, what and how many rows.
exports.step3: The file contains customers' personal data: keep it only on a work device and do not forward it in messengers.
exports.readOnly: View only: the data is exported by the administrator.
exports.needSection: The export needs access to the data: the "{{section}}" section is required — give the administrator a second role.

leads.title: Leads
leads.purpose: Name, language, stage, score, owner, need, last message.

clients.title: Customers
clients.purpose: Name, tax ID, segment, owner, open deals, last activity.

deals.title: Deals
deals.purpose: Title, customer, product, amount, stage, dates, rejection reason, owner.

errors.DEFAULT: The action was not completed. Try again later or contact the administrator.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This action is not available to your role.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The object was not found: it may have been changed already. Refresh the page.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: CRM is not responding. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.INTEGRATION_FAILED: A service needed for the action did not respond. Try again later.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: CRM did not accept the values: check the marked fields.
errors.CONFLICT: The object has changed. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: The session has expired. Sign in again.

reasons.litellm_unavailable: The model gateway is not responding: the dry run is unavailable now. Try again later.

texts.name: Name
texts.tableScroll: Bot texts: the table can be scrolled
texts.caption: Bot texts of this group
texts.search: Find a text by name or situation
texts.step1: The edit appears in the section form; it reaches CRM after "Save" in the section header.
texts.step2: Placeholders such as {name} and {manager} are replaced when sending; CRM rejects stray curly braces.
texts.step3: After saving, customers get the new text from the bot's next message.

greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.when: The first message to a customer after /start.

consent.label: Consent request
consent.when: Right after the greeting, before any bot reply.

consent_button.label: "I agree" button
consent_button.when: A button under the consent request.

consent_decline_button.label: "I do not agree" button
consent_decline_button.when: A button under the consent request.

consent_accepted.label: Consent received
consent_accepted.when: After "I agree", if the customer has not asked anything yet.

consent_accepted_pending.label: Consent received, question already asked
consent_accepted_pending.when: After "I agree", if there is already a question — the bot answers it right away.

consent_declined.label: Consent declined
consent_declined.when: If the customer pressed "I do not agree".

consent_required.label: Consent reminder
consent_required.when: If the customer writes without confirming consent.

language_prompt.label: Language choice
language_prompt.when: On the /lang command, above the language buttons.

smalltalk_ack.label: Reply to "thanks" and "got it"
smalltalk_ack.when: When a customer thanks or agrees — the bot replies with this text without AI.

handoff.label: Handoff to a manager (working hours)
handoff.when: When the dialog is handed to the team during working hours. {sla} — the "Response time promise" text.

off_hours.label: Handoff to a manager (off hours)
off_hours.when: Outside working hours. {next} — the nearest working time with holidays, {hours} — the schedule.

waiting_for_manager.label: Waiting for a manager
waiting_for_manager.when: If the customer writes while waiting for a manager.

manager_joined.label: Manager joined
manager_joined.when: When a manager takes the dialog. {manager} — the manager's name.

returned_to_bot.label: Dialog returned to the bot
returned_to_bot.when: When a manager returns the dialog to the bot.

handoff_offer_yes.label: "Hand off to a manager" button
handoff_offer_yes.when: Under the "not in the knowledge base" reply.

handoff_offer_no.label: "No need" button
handoff_offer_no.when: Under the "not in the knowledge base" reply.

attachment_received.label: File received
attachment_received.when: When a customer sends a file — the file goes to the team.

attachment_too_large.label: File larger than 20 MB
attachment_too_large.when: When a customer sends a file over 20 MB — the bot asks for a link, the file is not saved.

fallback.label: No answer in the knowledge base
fallback.when: When the bot found no answer; below it — the "Hand off to a manager" and "No need" buttons.

service_unavailable.label: AI assistant failure
service_unavailable.when: If the AI model is unavailable. The customer's message is saved for the team.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.when: While Telegram is switched off manually in "External services": a reply to any message, no more than once in 10 minutes per chat.

rate_limited.label: Messages too frequent
rate_limited.when: When a customer exceeds the messages-per-minute limit (the "Bot behaviour" section).

unsupported_message.label: Unsupported message
unsupported_message.when: For stickers, video and other messages the bot does not understand.

document_sent.label: Sending a document
document_sent.when: Before the document file to a customer. {title} — the document title.

document_failed.label: Document not sent
document_failed.when: If Telegram did not accept the file.

service_request_closed.label: Reply to a service request
service_request_closed.when: When a manager closed the request. {number} — number, {summary} — essence, {resolution} — answer.

erase_confirm.label: Deletion confirmation
erase_confirm.when: On the /delete command, before the conversation is deleted.

menu_start.label: Menu: /start
menu_start.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for prospective customers.

menu_human.label: Menu: /human
menu_human.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for customers and for prospects while no manager handles the lead.

menu_lang.label: Menu: /lang
menu_lang.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for everyone.

menu_help.label: Menu: /help
menu_help.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for everyone.

menu_delete.label: Menu: /delete
menu_delete.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for everyone.

menu_docs.label: Menu: /docs
menu_docs.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for customers.

menu_request.label: Menu: /request
menu_request.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for customers.

menu_status.label: Menu: /status
menu_status.when: The command label in the Telegram "Menu" button — for customers.

docs_list.label: Document list
docs_list.when: Above the document buttons on the /docs command.

docs_choose.label: Choosing from several documents
docs_choose.when: A customer asked for a document and several were found — above the document buttons.

docs_empty.label: No documents
docs_empty.when: A customer called /docs but has no documents.

request_prompt.label: Asking to describe a request
request_prompt.when: A customer called /request — the bot waits for a description in one message.

request_created.label: Request created
request_created.when: The request description is received and the request is handed to a manager. {number} — the request number.

request_status_open.label: Status: request in progress
request_status_open.when: A customer called /status and has an open request. {number}, {date}, {summary} — from the request.

request_status_none.label: Status: no open requests
request_status_none.when: A customer called /status and has no open requests.

phone_request.label: Asking to share a number
phone_request.when: Once: when a lead is qualified or asked for a manager (Bot behaviour → "Ask for a number").

phone_share_button.label: "Share the number" button
phone_share_button.when: Under the request to share a number; sends the customer's own number.

phone_skip_button.label: "Not now" button
phone_skip_button.when: Under the request to share a number.

phone_saved.label: Number saved
phone_saved.when: The customer shared their number with the button.

phone_skipped.label: Number not given
phone_skipped.when: The customer pressed "Not now". We will not ask again.

phone_not_own.label: Someone else's contact
phone_not_own.when: The customer sent someone else's contact — only their own number is saved.

phone_before_manager.label: Number before handing off to a manager
phone_before_manager.when: A lead without a number asks for a manager (Handoffs → "A request to call a manager — only after a number"). We hand off right after the number.

phone_declined_manager.label: Number not given — we do not call a manager
phone_declined_manager.when: A lead pressed "Not now" on the number request before a handoff. The bot keeps answering; it asks again on a new request.

help_with_manager.label: /help help (a manager handles)
help_with_manager.when: On /help while a manager handles the dialog. Lists this menu's commands.

help_client.label: /help help (customer)
help_client.when: On /help for a customer after the contract. Lists the customer menu commands.

client_access_granted.label: Access opened to the customer
client_access_granted.when: Once, when a manager made the lead a customer: /docs and /request are available.

request_text_only.label: Request — text only
request_text_only.when: A customer called /request and sent a file or a voice message instead of a description.

language_first.label: First message: language choice
language_first.when: The first message to a new contact — in three languages at once, with language buttons below.

handoff_offer_declined.label: Reply to "No need"
handoff_offer_declined.when: A customer pressed "No need" under the "not in the knowledge base" reply.

contacts.label: Company contacts: heading
contacts.when: On "give me the phone/address/site" — above the values from the "Company" section.

contact_labels.label: Company contacts: labels
contact_labels.when: Labels of the phone, site and address separated by "|" — in this order.

contacts_missing.label: Contacts not set
contacts_missing.when: Asked for a phone/address/site but they are empty in "Company"; the manager buttons are under the text.

sla_promise.label: Response time promise
sla_promise.when: Inserted into "Handoff to a manager" as {sla}. {minutes} — the SLA from the "Handoffs" section.

erp_quote_sent.label: Quote sent to the customer
erp_quote_sent.when: ERP event "quote sent". {deal} — the deal. Under the text — the "Open the quote" and "Cabinet" buttons.

erp_quote_acceptance_code.label: Quote confirmation code
erp_quote_acceptance_code.when: A customer pressed "Get a code" in the cabinet to accept a quote: the bot sends the code to the contact in Telegram. {deal} — deal, {code} — code, {minutes} — minutes it is valid. The code is stored nowhere.

erp_invoice_issued.label: Invoice issued
erp_invoice_issued.when: ERP event "invoice issued". {number} — number, {amount} {currency} — amount, {due} — due date.

erp_invoice_paid.label: Invoice paid
erp_invoice_paid.when: ERP event "payment received". {number} — invoice number, {amount} {currency} — amount.

erp_delivery_status.label: Delivery status
erp_delivery_status.when: ERP event "delivery status changed". {deal} — deal, {summary} — contents, {status} — status in words.

erp_delivery_statuses.label: Delivery status names
erp_delivery_statuses.when: Five names separated by "|" in order: being packed, on the way, ready to ship, shipped, delivered.

erp_delivery_eta_changed.label: Delivery date changed
erp_delivery_eta_changed.when: ERP event "delivery date changed". {deal} — deal, {summary} — contents, {eta} — the new date.

erp_act_issued.label: Act generated
erp_act_issued.when: ERP event "act generated". {number} — the act number.

erp_btn_quote.label: "Open the quote" button
erp_btn_quote.when: Under the quote message, leads to the quote page.

erp_btn_invoice.label: "Open the invoice" button
erp_btn_invoice.when: Under the invoice message, if ERP sent a link.

erp_btn_cabinet.label: "Cabinet" button
erp_btn_cabinet.when: Under ERP event messages, if the cabinet address is set in "Company".

erp_staff_quote_accepted.label: To staff: quote accepted
erp_staff_quote_accepted.when: A personal message to the person in charge. Sent in Russian. {client} — customer, {quote} — quote number, {deal} — deal.

erp_staff_act_returned.label: To staff: act returned
erp_staff_act_returned.when: A personal message to the person in charge. Sent in Russian. {number} — act number, {deal} — deal, {reason} — remarks.

erp_note_delivery_line_accepted.label: Feed: the customer accepted a delivery line
erp_note_delivery_line_accepted.when: An entry in the lead's feed. Written in Russian. {contact} — customer contact, {line} — line number, {title} — title, {deal} — deal.

erp_note_delivery_line_disputed.label: Feed: the customer disputed a delivery line
erp_note_delivery_line_disputed.when: An entry in the lead's feed. Written in Russian. {contact} — customer contact, {line} — line number, {title} — title, {deal} — deal, {remark} — remark.

erp_staff_delivery_line_disputed.label: To staff: a delivery line disputed
erp_staff_delivery_line_disputed.when: A personal message to the person in charge. Sent in Russian. {client} — customer, {line} — line number, {title} — title, {deal} — deal, {remark} — customer's remark.

fields.name: Company name
fields.crm_base_url: CRM address (for links in the channel)
fields.cabinet_url: Customer cabinet address (the "Cabinet" button in bot messages; empty — no button)
fields.phone: Company phone (the bot gives it when a customer asks)
fields.kb_gap_streak: "Not found" answers in a row before handoff
fields.qualifier_min_confidence: How confident the qualifier must be (0–1)
fields.min_score: Minimum similarity for the bot to answer (0–1)
fields.top_k: How many knowledge base fragments the bot reads before answering
fields.search_timeout_s: How many seconds to wait for the knowledge base search
fields.rate_limit_per_minute: Messages per minute from a customer
fields.ask_phone: Ask for a phone number once (qualified or asks for a manager)
fields.assist_enabled: AI help for the manager when replying ("Draft", "Improve")
fields.manager_dm_throttle_minutes: Pause between personal notifications to a manager
fields.price_always_to_manager: Any price question goes to a manager (even if the bot quoted a price from the price list)
fields.require_phone_for_human_request: A request to call a manager — only after a phone number
fields.min_any_of: How many additional facts are needed
fields.timeline_max: The timeline counts if it is
fields.decision_roles: Which roles in the decision count
fields.rate_limit_per_hour: Requests per hour from one address
fields.max_text_chars: Maximum characters in the "What do you need" field
fields.repeat_minutes: At most one service failure alert per

hints.cabinet_url: Customer cabinet address (https://…): the "Cabinet" button under bot messages about ERP events; empty — no button.
hints.max_text_chars: Maximum characters in the "What do you need" field.
hints.consent_version: Change the version — all customers confirm consent again.
hints.high_score_threshold: A lead with this score or higher is handed off to a manager.
hints.qualifier_min_confidence: Higher is stricter: fewer handoffs on the qualifier's recommendation.
hints.min_score: Higher is stricter: the bot says "I don't know" and offers a manager more often.
hints.sla_minutes: Working minutes until a reminder in the channel.
hints.human_request_terms: A word or phrase; Enter — add.
hints.require_phone_for_human_request: A lead without a number asks for a manager — the bot first asks to "Share the number" (spam protection) and hands off right after the number. Does not affect customers or handoffs on bot signals.
hints.terms: A word or the start of a word with * (complain* — complaint, complaints…); Enter — add.
hints.channel_id: A number with a minus sign, e.g. -100…; the bot must be an admin of the channel.
hints.duty_user_ids: They get an @mention in reminders about overdue handoffs.
hints.manager_dm_throttle_minutes: A lead writes several messages in a row — the manager gets one Telegram notification in this time.
hints.holidays: On these days SLA is not counted and the bot replies with the off-hours text.
hints.daily_usd: In US dollars. Above it — the dialog switches to the fallback model.
hints.erp_daily_usd: In US dollars per day (Tashkent time), 0 — no limit. ERP spend goes through the shared model gateway; exceeding is highlighted in "Spend" and "System status".
hints.anthropic: USD per day (Tashkent time), 0 — no limit. Above it — the dialog runs on the fallback model.
hints.gemini: USD per day (Tashkent time), 0 — no limit. Above it — the bot hands dialogs off to a manager.
hints.min_fill_seconds: A form sent faster is rejected: this filters out robots.
hints.token_ttl_minutes: After this time the form page must be refreshed.
hints.rate_limit_per_hour: Requests above the limit from this IP are rejected until the end of the hour.
hints.telegram_admins: To administrators who have Telegram linked in their profile and system notifications on.
hints.telegram_channel: "If not delivered to anyone personally" — the channel stays about leads, the team sees failures there only as a fallback.
hints.email_admins: To active administrators with an email; the "Mail" connector must be connected.
hints.extra_emails: For example, the engineer on duty; Enter — add.
hints.repeat_minutes: If a service "flickers", a new failure sooner than this is written to the incident log without a message.

options.fallback: If not delivered to anyone personally
